params.prompt: A full-page website design, desktop 1440 wide, for a welding shop's contact page styled as an industrial steel sign: a dark gunmetal panel with stencil-cut letters "TELL ME ABOUT THE JOB", one bold teal-blue hazard bar across, the attached chrome emblem riveted at the top left, form fields as hard-edged cut slots (Name, Phone, What do you need built or fixed?, Where is it?), a teal-blue button "Send the request", and "Text 425-283-6496 · Call · Instagram" as stencil tags. Masculine, industrial, crisp, legible, no rust, no wood.
